Why Deskbit

Less complexity.
More clarity.

Deskbit keeps things simple. Write it down, pin it, tidy up, and mark it done. That’s all.

Keep tasks in view

Pin a note to keep it visible, even across desktop Spaces. Unpin it when you’re done so it stays out of the way.

More notes, less clutter

Drag to select several notes, then move, pin, or unpin them together. One click arranges scattered notes into a tidy layout.

Done? Put it away

Click the checkmark to move a note from your desktop to History. Restore it whenever you need it, keeping your desktop clear and your notes safe.

No account needed Stored on your Mac Autosaved No ads or telemetry

How to install

Make room
for today.

Free to download. Requires macOS 11 or later.

Download Deskbit
1

Open the DMG

Open the downloaded DMG, drag Deskbit into Applications, then launch it from Applications.

2

Click “Done”

If you see the “Deskbit Not Opened” message, click “Done”.

3

Allow the app to open

macOS 13 or later
System Settings → Privacy & Security → click “Open Anyway” in the Security section.
macOS 11–12
System Preferences → Security & Privacy → General → click “Open Anyway”.
